prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet moment on a subway platform. On the far left, an elderly woman in a floral coat stands patiently, her posture slightly hunched against the chill. Next to her, a bright yellow suitcase rests upright on the concrete, its handle extended upward as if recently set down. In the center of the composition, a young man in a blue hoodie sits on a metal bench, his legs crossed casually while he reads a folded newspaper. Beside him, a small terrier with wiry fur sits attentively, looking up at the man with eager eyes. The man glances down at the dog, acknowledging its presence with a subtle smile, creating a gentle bond between them. To the right, a businessman in a gray suit checks his wristwatch, his expression tense and hurried. He points toward the tunnel entrance, signaling urgency to a teenager in a green backpack who stands nearby. The teenager looks in the direction indicated, shifting weight from one foot to the other in anticipation. There is no digital advertising screen visible on the walls, preserving the timeless, analog feel of the setting. The rough texture of the platform tiles is suggested through loose shading, while the distant tunnel mouth remains a dark, undefined void. The interplay of charcoal lines and faint watercolor hues defines the forms without overwhelming the delicate atmosphere of the underground space.
